#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded stream-equivalence gates followed by untraced ABBA phase timings."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

REPO = Path('/home/will/wk/exp/ferrum')
ROOT = Path('/tmp/ferrum-perf-explore-4bef39a/hash-cache')
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / 'tools/performance/smt'))
from run_saturation import check_outcome, sha, trial, write

ROOT.mkdir()
base = Path('/tmp/ferrum-deterministic-preamble-validation-complete')
spec = json.loads((base / 'spec.json').read_text())
spec['kind'] = 'native-term-hash-cache-v1'
spec['runtime_parent'] = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip()
patch = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--', 'crates/ferrum-silicon/src/state/terms.rs'], cwd=REPO)
(ROOT / 'runtime.patch').write_bytes(patch)
spec['runtime_patch_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest()
spec['options'][spec['options'].index('--timeout') + 1] = '60'
spec['outer_timeout'] = 90
spec['offline_timeout'] = 45
spec['repetitions'] = 1
spec['phase_commands'] = {'baseline': '/tmp/ferrum-perf-explore-4bef39a/baseline-phase-driver',
                          'candidate': str(REPO / 'target/debug/ferrum-phase-session')}
spec['host']['load'] = Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip()
spec['limits'] = ['Four candidate streams compared with previously validated baseline streams.',
    'Four fresh untraced phase sessions per positive case, ABBA, no retries.',
    'One worker, branches off, caches on, modern saturation, same dev build settings.',
    '60s program / 90s outer / 45s offline limits. Shared host, wall timings are noisy.',
    'Parsed Viper timings; backend phase excludes parsing but is not a fresh full Rust matrix.']
paths = [spec['z3'], spec['proxy'], spec['supervisor'], *spec['commands']['ferrum'],
    *spec['phase_commands'].values(), *(c['path'] for c in spec['cases']),
    str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(REPO / 'tools/performance/smt/run_saturation.py'),
    str(REPO / 'crates/ferrum-silicon/src/state/terms.rs'), str(base / 'summary.json')]
spec['artifact_sha256'] = {p: sha(p) for p in paths}
write(ROOT / 'spec.json', spec)
expected = {g['case']: g['trials'][0] for g in json.loads((base / 'summary.json').read_text())['groups']}
started = time.monotonic()
capture_root = ROOT / 'captures'
capture_root.mkdir()
gates = []
for case in spec['cases']:
    row = {'index': len(gates), 'case': case['name'], 'profile': 'modern',
           'backend': 'ferrum', 'repetition': 0, 'control': case['control']}
    result = trial(spec, row, capture_root)
    equal = {}
    if result['valid'] and len(result['traces']) == 1:
        t = result['traces'][0]
        folder = Path(t['folder'])
        old = expected[case['name']]
        equal = {'input': sha(folder / 'stdin.bin') == old['input_sha256'],
                 'output': sha(folder / 'stdout.bin') == old['output_sha256'],
                 'queries': t['query_count'] == old['queries']}
        for key in ['quant-instantiations', 'rlimit-count']:
            equal[key] = t['offline']['statistics'].get(key) == old['offline_statistics'].get(key)
    gate = {'case': case['name'], 'valid': result['valid'], 'equal': equal,
            'trial': str(Path(result['folder']) / 'trial.json')}
    gates.append(gate)
    write(ROOT / 'gates.json', gates)
    print('GATE', json.dumps(gate), flush=True)
    if not result['valid'] or not equal or not all(equal.values()):
        raise SystemExit('Stream equivalence gate failed; retained all evidence, no timing sweep.')

rows = []
for name in ['mut_element_nested_pass', 'mut_element_array_pass']:
    case = next(c for c in spec['cases'] if c['name'] == name)
    for variant in ['baseline', 'candidate', 'candidate', 'baseline']:
        folder = ROOT / f'{len(rows):02d}-{name}-{variant}'
        folder.mkdir()
        command = ['taskset', '--cpu-list', spec['cpu_affinity'], spec['phase_commands'][variant], spec['z3'],
            *spec['options'], '--parallelizeBranches=false', '--proverSaturationTimeout', '100',
            '--proverSaturationTimeoutWeights', spec['profiles']['modern']['weights'], '--', case['path']]
        supervisor = [sys.executable, spec['supervisor'], '--timeout', str(spec['outer_timeout']),
            '--output', str(folder / 'session.json'), '--', *command]
        print('PHASE START', len(rows), name, variant, flush=True)
        load = Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip()
        proc = subprocess.run(supervisor, env={**os.environ, 'FERRUM_BENCH_INTERNAL_CACHES':'on'}, capture_output=True, text=True)
        (folder / 'supervisor.log').write_text(proc.stdout + proc.stderr)
        session = json.loads((folder / 'session.json').read_text())
        phases = [json.loads(line.removeprefix('@@PERF@@')) for line in session['raw_output'].splitlines() if line.startswith('@@PERF@@')]
        row = {'index':len(rows), 'case':name, 'variant':variant, 'command':command,
            'session':str(folder / 'session.json'), 'wall_s':session['wall_seconds'],
            'phase_s':{p['phase']: int(p['elapsed_ns']) / 1e9 for p in phases},
            'load_before':load, 'load_after':Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip(),
            'valid':proc.returncode == 0 and check_outcome(session, case)}
        rows.append(row)
        write(ROOT / 'timings.json', rows)
        print('PHASE FINISH', name, variant, 'valid',row['valid'], 'wall',row['wall_s'], 'verify',row['phase_s'].get('session_verify_inclusive'), flush=True)
        if not row['valid'] or 'session_verify_inclusive' not in row['phase_s']:
            raise SystemExit('Invalid phase timing; no retry.')
errors = [p for p,h in spec['artifact_sha256'].items() if sha(p) != h]
summary = {'gates': gates, 'timings': rows, 'elapsed_s':time.monotonic() - started, 'postflight_errors':errors}
write(ROOT / 'summary.json', summary)
print('DONE', summary['elapsed_s'], 'postflight', errors, flush=True)
raise SystemExit(bool(errors))
